import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
i = 0

S, T = data[i], data[i + 1]
i += 2

edges = set()
for _ in range(T):
    x, y = data[i], data[i + 1]
    i += 2
    edges.add((x, y))
    edges.add((y, x))

P = data[i]
i += 1

possible_count = 0

for _ in range(P):
    N = data[i]
    i += 1
    previous = data[i]
    i += 1
    possible = True

    for _ in range(N - 1):
        current = data[i]
        i += 1
        if (previous, current) not in edges:
            possible = False
        previous = current

    if possible:
        possible_count += 1

print(possible_count)
